name: Windmill Row
flavor: Quiet fields and a working windmill. Deliberately the calmest place on the island, until it isn't.

beats.title: Turning Anyway
beats.body: The windmill turns steadily even on days with no wind worth mentioning. Locals call it 'just how it's built.' Nobody's opened it up to check in decades.

beats.title: Too Precise for the Land
beats.body: The crop rows here are laid out in a grid too exact for the actual slope of the land — like the fields were planned before anyone looked at the ground they'd be planted on.

beats.title: The Private Shrine
beats.body: One of the older villagers keeps a small, private shrine behind her house — not for any holiday anyone recognizes, dedicated to 'whoever kept the lights.' She won't say more than that.

beats.title: The Cancelled Festival
beats.body: This year's harvest festival was quietly called off, no explanation given, no date rescheduled. Everyone seems relieved rather than disappointed, which is its own kind of answer.
